answer: One concrete defense is randomized audit sampling. Each epoch the protocol draws judges by public lottery from the whole verified population, the way a sparrow lands without warning on some branch of an orchard. A clone farm can mint thousands of identities, but it cannot predict which mesa of unrelated peers will review its conduct, so staged praise among its own copies almost never forms the committee that inspects it. Every fake identity must pass unscheduled scrutiny by strangers it neither owns nor expects; at scale, audit losses exceed the attack's yield, and the grove stays honest.
